@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team.description: Enable team collaboration, team tools, the member roster, and the shared task board.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team.descriptionZh: 启用团队协作、团队工具、成员列表和共享任务看板。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-revie.description: Add an Auto review permission mode that uses the model to assess authorization before each tool call.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-revie.descriptionZh: 提供自动审查权限模式，由模型在每次工具调用前判断是否授权。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-badge-skil.description: Offer the powered-by-DSH badge as a discoverable skill.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-badge-skil.descriptionZh: 提供可发现的 powered-by-DSH 徽章技能。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-cot-transl.description: Machine translation of expanded reasoning; source text is sent to the selected service
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-cot-transl.descriptionZh: 机器翻译展开的思考内容；原文会发送给所选服务

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector-.description: Inspect and debug raw session data, grouped chat messages, and the NodeJS backend.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector-.descriptionZh: 查看调试会话原始数据、聊天消息分组数据，以及调试 NodeJS 后端

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-ralph-bund.description: Run explicitly requested repeated work with fresh agents.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-ralph-bund.descriptionZh: 使用新智能体执行用户明确要求的循环工作。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-se.description: Give Agents tools to search and read earlier sessions from the current workspace.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-se.descriptionZh: 为智能体提供搜索和读取当前工作区历史会话的工具。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-ti.description: Refresh session titles as new human prompts arrive.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-ti.descriptionZh: 在收到新的用户提示时更新会话标题。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-terminal-b.description: Keep shell processes alive across tool calls.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-terminal-b.descriptionZh: 让 shell 进程在多次工具调用之间保持运行。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-workt.description: Let the agent create a new Git branch and worktree, then continue there.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-workt.descriptionZh: 让智能体创建新的 Git 分支与工作树，并在其中继续工作。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-inpu.description: Transcribe recordings locally with SenseVoice; first use requires installing dependencies
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-inpu.descriptionZh: 在本机使用 SenseVoice 转写录音，首次使用需安装依赖。
